name: PDF Read
description: Extract text from a PDF. Provide the source ONE of three ways: path (an absolute file path on the Hearth host), data_url (a data:application/pdf;base64,… inline payload), or collateral_id (a PDF saved to Collateral). Optional: pages (a range like '1-5' or '3', defaults to all pages). Returns the extracted text plus a page count.
author: hearth-team
